# `planroom`

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED by cargo xtask gen from docs/contributing/repo-layout.md's area tables; do not edit -->

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** the CLI, the server, the live loop, app services (orchestration only), actor resolution, workspace trust, consent cards, pack loading and embedding, canvas embedding, config (workspace and user-level), the string catalog, the daemonizing of `serve --detach`.
- **May depend on:** every workspace crate, and its allow-list in `boundaries.toml`: `axum`, `tower-http`, `tokio`, `tokio-stream`, `tracing`, `anyhow`, `clap`, `serde`, `serde_json`, `toml`, `uuid`, `libc` (fork and `setsid` only) [DR-69], `p256` [DR-72] [DR-79].
- **Must not:** business rules that belong in the kernel; spelling an error code outside the registry; reading a credential setting from a workspace's config.
- **How to test it:** scenario tests `tests/sNN_*.rs`, `budgets.rs`, `actor.rs`, `trust.rs`, `privacy.rs`, `live_gate.rs`, `backup.rs`, `git_hardening.rs`, `handoff_clone.rs`, `evals.rs` (the kernel's eval recompute over pack files), golden outputs.

Read first, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [Surfaces](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#surfaces); [Local server and live stream](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#local-server-and-live-stream); [Actors](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#actors); [Where the workspace lives](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#where-the-workspace-lives); [Packaging and release](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#packaging-and-release).
- **Records:** [DR-4](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-4-actor-identity-and-actor-rules), [DR-29](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-29-browser-login-with-a-one-time-code), [DR-58](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-58-one-data-root-a-self-locating-resolver-an-embedded-canvas-and-visible-background-work), [DR-64](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-64-agents-never-hold-the-persons-authority), [DR-69](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-69-releases-from-main-a-portable-detach-and-a-resolver-contract), [DR-74](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-74-repo-namespaces-that-survive-duplicates-and-renames-and-a-single-repos-state-in-its-git-directory), [DR-75](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-75-authority-stays-with-a-persons-own-action), [DR-77](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-77-every-pane-action-within-two-keys-and-an-artifact-that-serves-a-cloud-session), [DR-78](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-78-releases-users-install-detached-work-in-its-own-session-a-canvas-port-that-never-moves-and-machine-wide-files-across-versions), [DR-80](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-80-hand-off-results-land-however-the-change-reaches-the-tracked-branch).
